final_message:
All 11 tests pass. Implementation summary:

- **`src/cache.ts`** — Full `TtlCache` implementation: expiry check is `now < expiresAt` (where `expiresAt = storedAt + ttlMs`), so an entry stored at `t=1000` with a 500ms lifetime is served at 1499 and gone at exactly 1500. Includes per-entry TTL override, lifetime restart on re-`set`, expired-first eviction with oldest-`set` tie-breaking, input validation (`RangeError`), and `prune()` cleanup.
- **`tests/cache.test.ts`** — Fixed the one contradictory test (`"an entry is still served at exactly ttlMs"` claimed the opposite of the requirement) and added a regression test mirroring the exact `t=1000 → t=1500` scenario from the request.
